# Triage of changes on 2026-06-15

## Launchpad

#### [LP #2104373](https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+bug/2104373) [netplan.io](http://netplan.io) — [Bug] Failed ‘netplan set’ operation doesn’t return non-0 error (Netplan 1.1.1 …

This is now fixed upstream. We can consider SRUing it to Jammy, Noble and

Resolute after it is fixed in Stonking. Tagged as server-todo.

### Old items

#### [LP #2136126](https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+bug/2136126) nginx — insufficient security settings for nginx systemd services

I think it might be a good idea to consider adding some hardening to nginx in

Stonking. There was some discussion on the nginx mailing list about this back

in 2020, but I don’t know how much of that is still relevant today.
